# Michaela Alexander-Copeland — Communications Portfolio

Portfolio of Michaela Alexander-Copeland, Social Media Lead at HAUS, previously
Senior Integrated Communications / Senior Business Communications Analyst at RTX.
Nearly 10 years in social media, communications, content strategy, and PR.
Based in Huntsville, Alabama.

This is a single-page site. All sections are in index.html, reached by hash
links. Replace tripswithm and MichaelaCopelandPortfolio with the real GitHub Pages address.

## Highlights

- Social Media Lead at HAUS: 791K+ organic LinkedIn impressions, 13.7K+ reactions
  across B2B tech clients (Rune Technologies, Mayman Aerospace, Corridian, and more).
- At RTX: launched RTX's first LinkedIn newsletter, "News from RTX," growing it to
  200K+ subscribers and averaging 80K+ monthly views; 30+ articles on RTXConnections.
- Founder of What to Eat Huntsville (17.6K+ TikTok followers) and Trips with M.
